/**
     * Finds the nearest shared component between two upward component paths.
     * Both paths are ordered from the focused component toward the root.
     * @param {String[]} oldComponentPath Previous component path
     * @param {String[]} newComponentPath New component path
     * @returns {String|null} closest common component id
     * @protected
     */
classData.description: Finds the nearest shared component between two upward component paths. Both paths are ordered from the focused component toward the root.
classData.name: getClosestCommonComponentId

classData.comment:
/**
     * A focusout raised while the engine removed a node carries that node's id as `data.removedNodeId`.
     * When that node is the root of a floating component which is shown again by the time the leave
     * comes due, the leave belongs to the removed mount: a floating component requests focus whenever
     * it mounts (`component.Base#afterSetMounted`), so its new mount reports its own focus, and
     * delivering the old leave would dismiss it.
     * @param {Object} opts
     * @param {Object} opts.data dom event infos
     * @returns {Boolean}
     * @protected
     */
classData.description: A focusout raised while the engine removed a node carries that node's id as data.removedNodeId. When that node is the root of a floating component which is shown again by the time the leave comes due, the leave belongs to the removed mount: a floating component requests focus whenever it mounts (component.Base#afterSetMounted), so its new mount reports its own focus, and delivering the old leave would dismiss it.
classData.name: isRemovedFloatingShownAgain

classData.comment:
/**
     * A focusin that finds a focusout still waiting completes a move; otherwise focus enters. The browser raises both
     * halves of a move in one task, so the wait decides the pair, never the time the App Worker took between them.
     * @param {Object} opts
     * @param {Array}  opts.componentPath Component ids upwards
     * @param {Object} opts.data dom event infos
     * @protected
     */
classData.description: A focusin that finds a focusout still waiting completes a move; otherwise focus enters. The browser raises both halves of a move in one task, so the wait decides the pair, never the time the App Worker took between them.
classData.name: onFocusin

classData.comment:
/**

     * floating component that is shown again by then ({@link #isRemovedFloatingShownAgain}).
     * @param {Object} opts
     * @param {Array}  opts.componentPath Component ids upwards
     * @param {Object} opts.data dom event infos
     * @protected
     */
classData.description: A focusout waits {@link #maxFocusInOutGap} for its focusin, then counts as a leave — unless the engine removed a floating component that is shown again by then ({@link #isRemovedFloatingShownAgain}).
classData.name: onFocusout
